source_text: Legally, this disparity manifests in global prohibitions on FGC—criminalized in over 40 countries with penalties up to life imprisonment—while male circumcision, including khitan, enjoys legal tolerance or endorsement in most jurisdictions, predicated on divergent harm-benefit profiles substantiated by medical consensus. [100]
